create_SpotGazeEnv: create a SpotGazeEnv instance with config and spot robot to control gaze-based arm movements
reset_SpotGazeEnv: reset the SpotGazeEnv by moving the arm to initial joint angles and opening the gripper
step_SpotGazeEnv: step the SpotGazeEnv with an action dict to execute grasp decisions and return observations
get_observations_SpotGazeEnv: get observations including arm depth images, bounding boxes, and joint angles from SpotGazeEnv
create_SpotSemanticGazeEnv: create a SpotSemanticGazeEnv instance to approach and grasp objects using topdown or side grasping strategies
